ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white central pixels to low-intensity black edge and mottling pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous high-intensity white region flanked by dense, irregular low-intensity black mottling concentrated along the trailing edge and outer lateral margins. Clusters of dark focal spots are present in the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and significant bounding-box depth relative to fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration along the entire visible trailing edge, characterized by numerous jagged peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the upper trailing edge leading to irregular, bulbous lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and sub-circular low-intensity pixel clusters scattered across the white ventral surface, concentrated in the lower lobes and near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue masses at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating significant prior trauma or localized colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark focal point located on the vertical axis directly below the median notch vertex.
